Cinematic wide-format cover illustration for "Inside Modern Semiconductors", subtitled "From wafer to package".
Theme: semiconductor manufacturing, robotic inspection, advanced packaging.
Visual approach: abstract geometric with clean modern lines.
Composition: strong central focal point, negative space in upper third for text overlay.
Color palette: deep navy transitioning to electric blue with warm amber accents.
Atmosphere: professional, aspirational, forward-looking, modern and aspirational sensibility.
Inspired by the article's core concepts, 
create a visually striking hero image with dramatic volumetric lighting,
fine detail textures, and cinematic depth of field.
Magazine-quality digital art with strong visual hierarchy., 8K, ultra-high-quality, masterpiece, cinematic composition, rule of thirds, volumetric lighting, dramatic shadows, fine detail textures, professional color grading, handcrafted layered matte paper planes, readable foreground subject and background bands, visible paper fibers and clean cut edges, one soft directional light, consistent shallow shadows between layers, restrained palette, clear focal opening, avoid: glossy plastic, clay surfaces, floating pieces, inconsistent light direction, excessive filigree, crowded decorative props, realistic human skin, invented text, logos
